description.label: Description
description.value:
Trivial Mental Mutation, Tolerable

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.Q2MCUrG2HppMcvN0]{Animosity} Psychology towards a certain species or social group. Consult the Social Groups Table (see the @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.items.Item.cSg2OEDZDY6g7E0p]{Irrational Contempt} mutation) or let the GM decide. Getting this result again will upgrade your @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.Q2MCUrG2HppMcvN0]{Animosity} to @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.5hH73j2NgPdsLCZN]{Hatred}. Alternatively you can add another Target for your Animosity.
